symbolRegressionCheck.method: x86_64-w64-mingw32-strings cip-desktop.exe | grep -c <symbol>, run against the extracted installer's main executable. Every tripwire from Phase 24.3.1's own baseline (the most recent prior rebuild) was re-checked.
symbolRegressionCheck.tripwiresFromPriorPhasesDeviation: One: retry_paraphrase_or_semantic_with_fuller_context dropped from its Phase 24.3.1 baseline of 2 to 1 this rebuild. Investigated via `x86_64-w64-mingw32-nm cip-desktop.exe | c++filt`: only the core/service::bible_intelligence copy (_ZN16cip_core_service18bible_intelligence48retry_paraphrase_or_semantic_with_fuller_context...) remains a linked `T` symbol; the apps/desktop pipeline.rs copy that contributed the second occurrence in every prior rebuild is no longer present as its own linker symbol. `git diff 86f874c d9bd2d3 -- apps/desktop/src-tauri/src/pipeline.rs core/service/src/bible_intelligence.rs` is byte-for-byte empty - neither function's source changed at all since the last verified rebuild. This confirms the deviation is a pure codegen/inlining artifact: the pipeline.rs copy (a small function with one call site) was fully inlined into its caller by LLVM this build, most likely because unrelated new code added to commands.rs (QualityBacklogState, classify_quality_backlog, and its call sites) shifted that translation unit's size/optimization heuristics enough to change this one inlining decision. Confirmed benign - not a functional regression, both underlying functions are unchanged and both still exist in source, only the desktop-local one no longer survives as a separate linked symbol in this particular build.
symbolRegressionCheck.newTripwiresThisPhaseNote: classify_quality_backlog (the new pure function this phase derives QualityBacklogState from) shows 0, matching the exact same already-established pattern as classify_model_size_tier, should_flush_early, and should_attempt_interim_decode above (all 0 in this and every prior baseline): a small helper with a single call site (get_pilot_diagnostics) is a textbook LLVM inlining target in a release build and is expected to leave no standalone linker symbol. Its 5 unit tests (compiled only under #[cfg(test)], never part of this release binary) are the direct evidence this function exists and behaves correctly - the same testing-boundary precedent every other 0-count tripwire in this table already relies on. QualityBacklogState's own string variants ("normal"/"busy"/"falling_behind"/"overloaded") were also confirmed present via `strings | grep falling_behind` (1 occurrence), independently confirming the enum's serde serialization code compiled into this build.
